assertions.reason: The Cargo macOS bundle metadata defines stable, preview, nightly, and dev variants with Neo Zed display names, dev.neozed-derived identifiers, and the neozed URL scheme.

evidence.summary: bundle-stable, bundle-preview, bundle-nightly, and bundle-dev each expose the expected Neo Zed name, dev.neozed* identifier, and osx_url_schemes = ["neozed"].
Saved the extracted per-channel macOS bundle metadata and scoped legacy-identity absence check to evidence/desktop-packaging/macos-windows-packaging/metadata-audit.json.

assertions.reason: The audited macOS packaging resources and install/uninstall flows use Neo Zed names: DocumentTypes advertises Neo Zed Text Document, the bundle script emits neozed DMG archives, and install/uninstall scripts use Neo Zed app names and neozed CLI paths.

evidence.summary: CFBundleTypeName is set to Neo Zed Text Document in the release-facing macOS document type metadata.
The bundling script sets bundle_archive_name="neozed" so generated DMGs use the Neo Zed archive name.
The macOS installer downloads Neo-Zed-$arch.dmg, prints Installing Neo Zed, and symlinks /Applications/$app/Contents/MacOS/neozed.
The macOS uninstall flow switches among Neo Zed.app, Neo Zed Preview.app, Neo Zed Nightly.app, and Neo Zed Dev.app with matching dev.neozed* app IDs.
plutil reported the DocumentTypes plist as OK before the metadata audit was recorded.

assertions.reason: The Windows installer-visible product metadata is rebranded to Neo Zed across the Inno Setup script and per-channel bundling definitions, with Neo Zed app names, dev.neozed AppUserModelIDs, and neozed setup artifact names.

evidence.summary: Each channel maps to Neo Zed / Neo Zed Preview / Neo Zed Nightly / Neo Zed Dev, uses neozed-$Architecture setup names, and publishes dev.neozed* AppUserModelIDs.
The installer metadata sets AppPublisher=Neo Zed and points AppPublisherURL, AppSupportURL, and AppUpdatesURL to https://neozed.dev/.
Saved the per-channel Windows installer mapping plus scoped legacy-string absence checks to evidence/desktop-packaging/macos-windows-packaging/metadata-audit.json.

assertions.reason: Windows package identities and shell integration use Neo Zed values: AppX manifests declare dev.neozed* identities and Neo Zed display names, Inno Setup registers the neozed protocol, and the explorer command uses the Open with Neo Zed label.

evidence.summary: The stable AppX manifest uses Name="dev.neozed", Publisher="CN=Neo Zed, O=Neo Zed, C=US", and DisplayName/PublisherDisplayName values for Neo Zed.
The preview/nightly/dev AppX manifests follow the same pattern with dev.neozed.Preview, dev.neozed.Nightly, and dev.neozed.Dev identities and matching Neo Zed display names.
The Windows explorer command fallback label is Open with Neo Zed.
Inno Setup registers Software\Classes\neozed with the URL:Neo Zed Protocol label and uses AppUserModelID references throughout the shell integration rules.
Saved the AppX identity matrix, shell-label evidence, and scoped absence checks to evidence/desktop-packaging/macos-windows-packaging/metadata-audit.json.

Remaining Windows payload names such as Zed.exe and zed_explorer_command_injector.appx are non-user-facing internal/runtime identifiers outside the installer-visible/package-identity assertions.
